featured_reviews.review_text:
The pet market in Mumbai, also known as Crawford Market, is a popular destination for pet lovers. The market offers a variety of pets for sale, including dogs, cats, birds, fish, and small animals like rabbits and guinea pigs.
While some visitors appreciate the variety of pets available at the market, others have expressed concerns about the welfare of the animals sold there. Some have reported seeing animals kept in cramped and unsanitary conditions, which can lead to health problems.
It's important to remember that pet ownership is a serious responsibility, and prospective pet owners should carefully consider their decision before purchasing an animal. It's also recommended to adopt from animal shelters or reputable breeders rather than purchasing from pet markets, to ensure that animals are well-cared for and treated ethically.

featured_reviews.name: Anuvhuti Bisht
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular client of Heads Up For Tails Spa, Colaba for my dog Alfie (goes by alfie.beinggolden on Instagram), so it’s safe to say that I have a bit of experience with them and I am also qualified to make an honest review here.

First of all, I’d like to thank our groomer, Sochipem, today. He did a brilliant job.

The staff is really lovely and they know what they are doing. They ask many questions from you to figure out your pet’s temperament, allergies (if any), concerns and requirements. Post the spa they give you a detailed feedback of everything they came across during the spa session and they even give you a report card with your dog’s physical health issues like rashes, dental and infections, so you get a nice picture of everything they have noticed during the bath. The only negative feedback I can give regards to the grooming is that they need a little bit more training on hair cutting. It’s only moderately okay.

The spa is inside a full fledged HUFT store so you know that you’ll get everything there to meet your pet’s needs. They have everything in every price bracket and affordability.

The HUFT store & spa stands in a prime location regard to connectivity, shoppers hub, food options.
So, while your pet is getting groomed, you can go to the causeway market to do some street shopping, or go to a restaurant/cafe to grab a quick meal, or just visit the gateway to reminisce (I mean, whatever floats your boat). I like to go to the leopold cafe and try a new dish off the menu each time.

So, all in all, Heads Up For Tails Stores & Spa, Colaba, will meet all your requirements. And you can take your pet out for their grooming while making a day out of it for yourself too.

Summary Review:
Grooming: 5/5
Hair Cutting: 4/5
HUFT Store: 5/5
Prices: 5/5
Staff: 5/5

I purchased a Shih Tzu puppy on 23/03/2026 from Zunjar Pet Shop, and this has been one of the worst and most heartbreaking experiences of my life.
The sales executive Salman emotionally pressures and misleads customers into buying puppies that are already sick. He makes false commitments at the time of sale and within just a few days, he completely denied knowing me or my pet. This is highly unprofessional and unethical.
I was not provided any vaccination records, certificates, or proper guidance. The puppy was already infected, and within just 4 days started showing serious symptoms like vomiting, diarrhea, lethargy, and gastro issues. Later, we also discovered ringworm infection, which clearly shows the poor hygiene and neglect at the shop.
The owners Bhagwan, Ajinkya, and Mohan are equally irresponsible and least bothered to address customer concerns. There is absolutely no accountability, no support, and no concern for the animals’ health.
Even more shocking:
The pets are kept in unclean and unhealthy cages
Wrong food guidance was given
My puppy stopped eating and drinking within days
Despite returning the puppy within 6 days due to critical health issues, NO REFUND was provided
Paying full amount and seeing the pet suffer within 7 days was something I never expected. This caused not only financial loss but emotional trauma for both me and the innocent puppy.
This is not just bad service — this is cruelty towards animals and cheating customers.
⚠️ I strongly urge everyone:
DO NOT buy pets, fish, or birds from this shop or any shop in Crawford Market.
They care only about money, not about the lives of innocent animals.
Absolutely FRAUD business. Worst experience ever. Not recommended at all. ❌

featured_reviews.name: Alay Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this pet shop, and I was deeply disturbed by the conditions I witnessed. The store clearly prioritizes profit over the well-being of the animals they sell. Many of the cages were overcrowded and filthy, and the animals seemed stressed and neglected. It was heart-wrenching to see puppies and kittens locked in small, uncomfortable spaces with no room to move or play. In fact, 90% of their pets have been infect with parvovirus.

It was obvious that these animals were being treated as products rather than living beings deserving of care and respect. The store was only interested in turning a quick profit, rather than ensuring the health and happiness of the animals in their care.

The treatment of animals here is unacceptable, and I will not be returning or recommending this shop to anyone. There are plenty of other pet shops that prioritize the animals’ health and happiness—this one certainly does not.

featured_reviews.name: P B
featured_reviews.review_text: My dog's stomach was upset n had started the same morning, but they suggested so many tests n medicines that were just not required. featured_reviews.name: Anisha Barai
featured_reviews.review_text:
This clinic is not entirely bad because I do remember getting my pet operated there in 2018 and it went rather well and the doctor that had operated her was extremely sweet as well with the pets and the pet parents.The disaster on the other hand began post op.

7-15 days after the operation, my dog started to have excessive and unstoppable nose bleeding and on having taken her to the Churchgate Petzone, and I remember waiting there what felt like an eternity just to get a doctor to attend to her and then came this young female doctor who behaved extremely rudely and clearly the only two doctors had no clue what do with my poor little pet who clearly was in pain. Then the next horror began when they started coordinating with their senior doctor over the phone and everythinf seemed like chaos for the next few hours! They decided to sedate her and my pet's bleeding finally stopped.

And after all this, nobody could tell us what actually had happened to my dog and the bleeding continued for the next few days too. Anyway, I never really took her there again because what's a clinic if you can't treat patients calmly in an emergency! I repeat again though, NOT ALL DOCTORS IN THE CLINIC ARE BAD, just this one and the only horrific experience.
